'''Dynaroth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]], Dynaroth was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

A noted [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi instructor|instructor]], Dynaroth was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as part of the Jedi presence while the majority of the Order relocated to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] following the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Dynaroth frequented the Senate Commerce Hall in the heart of the [[Senate Commercial District]] under the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. He helped the future [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] to chose which path to follow in [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighthood]], the ways of the [[Jedi Sage]] or of the [[Jedi Shadow]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dynaroth appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Advanced Class trainer for the Jedi Consular class, wherein players were sent to him by Master [[Ostar-Gal]] to learn the skills of either a [[Jedi Sage]] or a [[Jedi Shadow]]. He was removed in Game Update 5.0, when advanced classes were made available on character creation rather than level 10.<ref name="TOR" />
